Master.g1.label: Request submitted

intake.written_request_required.summary: A request must be in writing and delivered by U.S. mail, e-mail, hand delivery, or another method the governmental body has approved (e.g., fax, submission through its website).

Master.g1.city_config: Which channels the city actually operates (portal / form / paper / phone) — statute constrains, city chooses.

Master.g4.label: Acknowledgment auto-sent
Master.g4.city_config: Auto-acknowledgment text + send timing; statutory ack window where present, else city default (recommend: same business day).

Master.p3.label: Estimate Data

fee.estimate_and_notice.summary: If a copy charge (or a § 552.271 paper-inspection charge) will exceed $40, the body must give the requestor a written itemized statement detailing all estimated charges (including labor/personnel), notice of any less-costly alternative, and the requestor's response responsibilities.

The request is considered withdrawn if the requestor does not respond in writing within 10 business days after the itemized statement is sent (accepting charges, modifying the request, or filing an overcharge complaint).
fee.estimate_and_notice.clock_spec: 10 business-days from date the itemized statement is sent

fee.estimate_and_notice.summary: If, before making the copy available, the body determines estimated charges will exceed the itemized statement by 20% or more, it must send a written updated itemized statement; no timely response to the update means the request is withdrawn.

Master.p3.city_config: Which data points intake must capture to estimate (page count, media, labor class).

payment.deposit.summary: The officer may require a deposit or bond for unpaid amounts owed on prior requests if those unpaid amounts exceed $100, and this becomes the sole means of collecting those amounts.

payment.deposit_threshold.summary: The officer may require a deposit or bond for anticipated copy costs once an itemized estimate has been provided and the estimated charge exceeds $100 (body with more than 15 full-time employees) or $50 (fewer than 16 full-time employees).

Master.bv.label: VAGUE → Clarification
Master.bv.city_config: Vagueness screen wording; the reasonably-describes standard is statutory where present.

denial.no_responsive_records.summary: If the governmental body determines it has no information responsive to a request, the officer for public information must notify the requestor in writing not later than the 10th business day after the date the request is received.
denial.no_responsive_records.clock_spec: 10 business days from receipt of the request

Master.f2.label: Estimate Review (config: $ threshold +
Master.f2.city_config: Estimate-review $ threshold + reviewer role — pure city policy (recommend: supervisor review over $50).

Clarification.n2.label: Send clarification / assist request

clarification.clarification_process.summary: If a request is unclear the body may ask the requestor to clarify; if a large amount is requested the body may discuss narrowing the scope.
A written clarification/discussion request (or a request for additional info) must include a statement of the consequences of the requestor's failure to timely respond.

Clarification.n2.city_config: Clarification letter template; TX requires consequences-warning content; OK SB 535 3-element specificity.

Clarification.n3.label: Await requester response

clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.summary: If the body receives no written response by the 61st day after sending a clarification/discussion request (or additional-information request), the underlying request is considered withdrawn.
clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.clock_spec: 61 days from date clarification/discussion request sent

Clarification.n3.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law for most states: response window before close. Statutory: MO 90d · TX 61d. Recommend default 30d.

Clarification.close.label: CLOSE item (withdrawn)

clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.summary: If the body receives no written response by the 61st day after sending a clarification/discussion request (or additional-information request), the underlying request is considered withdrawn.
clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.clock_spec: 61 days from date clarification/discussion request sent

Clarification.close.city_config: Close-as-withdrawn notice; statutory consequence in MO/TX, city policy elsewhere.

Clarification.d4.label: Materially revised?
Clarification.d4.city_config: Materially-revised test (treat as NEW request → new clock, vs. continue) — pure city policy; recommend: new scope = new request.

Disposition.fmt.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

eligibility.incarcerated_requester_exclu.summary: A governmental body is not required to accept or comply with a request from an incarcerated/confined individual or that individual's agent (other than the individual's attorney seeking disclosable information).

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person may apply to the officer for public information and the officer shall promptly produce public information for inspection, duplication, or both.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: The governmental body may not inquire into the purpose for which the requested information will be used.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: There is no residency requirement; the right to request runs to 'any person' regardless of residence.

Master.s1.label: Fee-waiver requested

fee.waiver.summary: The body must provide a copy without charge or at a reduced charge if it determines waiver/reduction is in the public interest because providing the copy primarily benefits the general public.
The body may waive the charge if the cost of processing the collection of the charge would exceed the amount of the charge.

Master.s1.city_config: fee_waiver approval module (v1, DESIGN_fee_waiver_commercial.md): enabled on/off governs the DISCRETIONARY program only — statutory-mandatory waiver categories fire regardless, on verified evidence. mode = intake_review (inline approve/deny) | routed_task {assignee_role, task_name}.

Master.s2.label: Commercial-rate requested
Master.s2.city_config: commercial_rate approval module (v1): same two modes as fee_waiver (intake_review | routed_task). Must decide at INTAKE — commercial classification changes the response clock in NJ (14-bd) and IL (recurrent/commercial track). Classification overriding a self-declaration is always communicated.

Clarification.deny.label: Deny as vague / overbroad
Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

clarification.toll_on_clarification.authority: City of Dallas v. Abbott, 304 S.W.3d 380 (Tex. 2010)
clarification.toll_on_clarification.summary: A governmental body's good-faith request for clarification tolls the 10-business-day period for requesting an attorney general decision until the requestor responds.
clarification.toll_on_clarification.clock_spec: tolls the 10 business-day AG-request clock (TX-0018) from clarification sent until requestor responds

Estimate-Fee.dwv.label: Fee waiver

fee.waiver.summary: The body must provide a copy without charge or at a reduced charge if it determines waiver/reduction is in the public interest because providing the copy primarily benefits the general public.
The body may waive the charge if the cost of processing the collection of the charge would exceed the amount of the charge.

Estimate-Fee.dwv.city_config: Waiver decision point: resolved AFTER estimate computed, BEFORE estimate communicated — a waiver is always decided before any amount is invoiced. Denial is folded into the estimate notice (no separate letter); processing never stops — flows to the requester-response gate.

appeal.ag_referral_to_withhold.summary: A body that receives a written request for information it wishes to withhold under a Subchapter C exception must ask the attorney general for a decision, unless there has been a previous determination.

production.completion_window.summary: The officer must produce public information promptly, i.e., as soon as possible under the circumstances, within a reasonable time, without delay.
production.completion_window.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "promptly ... as soon as possible under the circumstances, that is, within a reasonable time, without delay" from request receipt

production.completion_window.summary: If information cannot be produced within 10 business days after receipt, the officer must certify that fact in writing to the requestor and set a date and hour, within a reasonable time, when it will be available.

If requested information is in active use or in storage and therefore unavailable when requested, the officer must certify this in writing and set a date and hour, within a reasonable time, when it will be available.

clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.summary: If the body receives no written response by the 61st day after sending a clarification/discussion request (or additional-information request), the underlying request is considered withdrawn.
clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.clock_spec: 61 days from date clarification/discussion request sent

clarification.toll_on_clarification.authority: City of Dallas v. Abbott, 304 S.W.3d 380 (Tex. 2010)
clarification.toll_on_clarification.summary: A governmental body's good-faith request for clarification tolls the 10-business-day period for requesting an attorney general decision until the requestor responds.
clarification.toll_on_clarification.clock_spec: tolls the 10 business-day AG-request clock (TX-0018) from clarification sent until requestor responds

payment.nonpayment_consequence.summary: A request is considered withdrawn if the requestor fails to inspect or duplicate the public information in the governmental body's offices on or before the 60th day after the date the information is made available, or fails to pay the postage and other applicable charges under Subchapter F on or …
payment.nonpayment_consequence.clock_spec: 60 calendar days from availability notice (inspection/duplication) or from charge notice (payment)

response.catastrophe_suspension.clock_spec: Up to 7 consecutive days + one 7-day extension (max 14 calendar days per catastrophe); requests during suspension deemed received the first business day after it ends; pending-request clocks tolled

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: The copy charge must be an amount that reasonably includes all costs related to reproducing the information, including materials, labor, and overhead.

fee.free_allowance.summary: For a request of 50 or fewer pages of paper records, the charge may not include materials, labor, or overhead and is limited to the per-page photocopy charge, unless the pages are in two-or-more unconnected buildings or a remote storage facility.

A body that sets time limits on uncompensated personnel time must allow at least 36 hours per requestor over a 12-month period and at least 15 hours per requestor in a one-month period before charging for personnel time.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: Charges for copies/inspection may not exceed the amounts established by attorney general rule; a non-state governmental body setting its own charges may not exceed the AG-established amounts by more than 25% absent an exemption.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: A governmental body may designate one mailing address and one e-mail address for requests; if it posts/prints them, it need not respond to a request unless received at a designated address, by hand delivery, or by an approved (a)(4) method.
